5. PROJECT SYNOPSIS (PROJECT PROPOSAL)

5.1 Problem Statement & Motivation

Individual retail investors actively manage diverse portfolios comprising domestic equities (NSE/BSE), commodities, mutual funds, and cash reserves. However, existing solutions are fragmented—either relying on manual spreadsheets that lack real-time price synchronization and automated alerts, or commercial brokerage platforms that monetize customer transaction data behind expensive subscriptions. Furthermore, retail investors routinely suffer from emotional trading, poor asset diversification, and lack institutional-grade risk auditing, instant price threshold notifications, or streamlined multi-PAN IPO allotment tracking.

5.2 Project Objectives

  • Unified Wealth Dashboard: Build a responsive, single-page web interface providing real-time net worth, daily profit/loss, and total return aggregation across Equities and Commodities.
  • Automated Market Ingestion: Connect to live market feeds via asynchronous multi-threaded workers (yfinance) with a 45-second cache to eliminate UI freezing and API throttling.
  • GenAI Risk & Diversification Audit: Integrate Groq Cloud LPU™ inference (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) to deliver objective portfolio health diagnostics, risk concentration scores, and actionable rebalancing strategies.
  • Real-Time Price Alert Engine: Implement a Groww/Zerodha-style target price monitoring engine with 60-second polling, Web Audio API two-tone sound chimes, and browser push notifications.
  • Multi-PAN Market Intelligence: Embed live NSE/BSE IPO status feeds, Grey Market Premium (GMP) indicators, and secure multi-PAN allotment verification with digit masking.
  • Privacy-First Cloud Architecture: Ensure secure multi-tenant data isolation using Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS), PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hashing, and resilient in-memory fallback caches.

5.3 Scope of the System

The project covers full-lifecycle investment tracking: user authentication (PBKDF2 / Google OAuth 2.0), multi-asset CRUD management (NSE/BSE Equities, MCX Commodities like Gold and Silver), automated asset allocation breakdown, interactive HTML5 Canvas charts (Chart.js 4.4), Groq AI diagnostics, real-time price alerts, multi-PAN IPO tracking, CSV data export, and printer-friendly PDF report generation.

5.4 Expected Project Deliverables

A production-ready web application backed by a modular Flask Application Factory (5 feature Blueprints: auth, holdings, prices, ai_copilot, ipo), a normalized Supabase PostgreSQL database schema, comprehensive UML architectural models, verified testing suites, and a complete technical documentation report.

Mini Project — Portfolio Tracker T.Y.B.Sc. Computer Science

6. REQUIREMENT SPECIFICATION

6.1 Functional Requirements

  • FR1 Authentication & Sessions: Secure user registration/login with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hashing (100,000 rounds), Google OAuth 2.0 single sign-on, HTTP-only cookie persistence, and welcome email dispatch.
  • FR2 Multi-Asset Portfolio (CRUD): Comprehensive tracking across Indian Equities (NSE/BSE) and MCX Commodities (Gold, Silver, Crude) with auto-calculated invested capital and weighted P&L metrics.
  • FR3 Market Engine & Live Price Alerts: 45s-cached live yfinance polling, OHLC charts, and Groww/Zerodha-style price alert triggers with sound chimes and native browser push alerts.
  • FR4 Visual Analytics & Allocation: Portfolio diversification breakdown across asset classes using interactive HTML5 Canvas charts (Chart.js 4.4) with real-time profit/loss color indicators.
  • FR5 Groq AI Portfolio Audit: GenAI risk diagnostic module powered by Groq Cloud LPU™ inference (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) delivering risk concentration analysis and rebalancing strategies.
  • FR6 Multi-PAN IPO & Export Engine: Live NSE/BSE IPO status with GMP tracking, masked Multi-PAN allotment verification, CSV data export, and print-ready PDF reports.

6.2 Non-Functional Requirements

  • NFR1 Performance & Latency: Sub-second dashboard load; parallel ThreadPoolExecutor workers with dual TTL cache stores (45s quotes, 300s charts) to eliminate API bottlenecks.
  • NFR2 Security & Compliance: Supabase Row Level Security (RLS), parameterized queries, XSS sanitization, client-side PAN masking, CORS protection, and secure HTTP headers.
  • NFR3 Fault Tolerance & Resilience: Dual-tier persistence with automatic fallback to resilient in-memory caches (_LOCAL_HOLDINGS_CACHE) during cold starts or network drops.
  • NFR4 Usability & Design: Responsive glassmorphic dark-mode interface with desktop sidebar, mobile drawer, and clear visual hierarchy across all devices.

Delete Holding Investor Clicks "Delete" on holding row Executes SQL DELETE query for specific holding ID Holding removed, doughnut charts redrawn

Request AI Audit Investor Clicks "Analyze Portfolio" Formats portfolio JSON, constructs prompt, dispatches to Groq LLM AI diagnostic report displayed with risk metrics
Fetch IPO Data Investor Navigates to "IPO Tracker" tab Queries NSE/BSE scraper, parses GMP updates Categorized table of active/upcoming IPOs rendered
Filter News Investor Selects news category or ticker Queries financial RSS feeds, filters by symbol Curated financial news headlines displayed
